title: #437 – Jordan Jonas: Survival, Hunting, Siberia, God, and Winning Alone Season 6
summary: Jordan Jonas is a wilderness survival expert, explorer, hunter, guide, and winner of Alone Season 6, a show in which the task is to survive alone in the arctic wilderness longer than anyone else. He is widely considered to be one of the greatest competitors in the history on that show.
